headline: Zenith Bank Posts US$690 Million Pre-Tax Profit for Nine Months
summary: Zenith Bank reported a 1.2% rise in pre-tax profit to US$690 million for the nine-month period, while profit after tax fell 11.6% to US$502 million due to higher taxes.
why: Banking sector results in major African economies highlight capital adequacy, tax burdens, and lending profitability trends.

impacts.name: Zenith Bank
impacts.why: Higher pre-tax profit offset by increased tax liabilities creates mixed net earnings results.
